title: Long Story Short — character data
description: The shape of the character's `data` field (a JSON string on the backend document; parse it to validate against this schema, stringify this shape to produce it). Does NOT cover the handful of sibling top-level columns (`edition`, `sheetEdition`, `spells` spellbook settings, `disabledBlocks`) or the `wizard` column — see docs/plans/character-toolkit.md (storyview repo) for those and for the full import envelope.
$comment: Schema checks SHAPE, not correctness. It cannot catch: a `charClass.id` that names no real dataset class, a `weapon.<id>.attack` bonus whose `<id>` matches no weapon in `weaponsList`, a `resources.*.location` naming no real `text` block, or an unparseable formula string. Validate the shape here, sanity-check cross-references yourself.

mode.description:
Layer operation. Replaces the legacy `kind`. Default: derived from `kind` for old data ('modifier'→'add', 'override'→'set'@100).

`add`/`set` and the roll modes `advantage`/`disadvantage` are what the manual bonus editor creates — its `+`/`_`/`=` and `↑`/`↓` buttons. `upgrade`/`downgrade`/`multiply` are dataset/grant-authoring primitives (e.g. proficiency-ordinal merging across independent grants); a bonus with one of these modes renders read-only in the sheet UI (no edit controls), regardless of `source.kind`.

priority.description: Stack priority (lower = applied first). Default: derived from `mode` via DEFAULT_PRIORITY; 'override' maps to LOCK_PRIORITY.

kind.deprecated: Use mode instead. Kept for backward compat with stored data.

value.description: Numeric value. Exactly one of value | expr should be set.

BonusTarget.description: Куда бьёт числовой бонус. Перечислены только ЖИВЫЕ таргеты — те, что лист действительно читает.
BonusTarget.$comment: Injected from bonusTargets.ts. Declared but unread families are omitted on purpose (a bonus there is a silent no-op): stat.modifier, hp.temp, vitality.darkvision, speed.other, attack.kind, damage.spell, proficiency, carry.

anyOf.description: Открытое семейство «weapon.attack» — ключ приходит из данных персонажа.
Открытое семейство «weapon.damage» — ключ приходит из данных персонажа.

BonusMode.description: Layer operation. Replaces the legacy `kind` field. `advantage` / `disadvantage` carry no value: the numeric fold skips them, the roll reads them (rollMode.ts, bonuses-and-items.md §1.4).

refId.description: Foreign id of the owning entity. Absent for 'user'.

label.description: Caption shown under source-owned rows (e.g. "Пояс силы великана").

disabled.description: Off: its bonuses don't count, their own per-bonus mute untouched.

icon.description: Key of the effect icon set (EffectIcon/constants.ts); absent — derived from its first bonus.

tone.description: What the effect means for the character — the icon's muted colour. Absent — neutral.

ends.description: Which rest turns it off: `short-rest` — either rest, `long-rest` — a long one; off, not deleted. Absent — until the player turns it off.

shown.description: Shown as a status while on (the sheet box, the table). Absent — shown: an effect switched on by hand is news. `false` — the player hid it: a ring, armour, already seen in the fields it changes.

CharacterEffect.description: A named set of bonuses switched on and off as a whole: Stone of Good Luck, Bless, a cloak. The record holds the effect's own state; its numeric changes are ordinary layers in `data.bonuses` with `source: { kind: 'effect', refId: id }`. The effect lives on with no bonuses — it isn't derived from them.

StatusTone.description: Buff or debuff: a meaning, not a colour — each theme picks its own muted shade.

bonuses.description: Per-stat targeted bonuses (reducer `stat-bonus-*`); kept if present.

shadowTemp.description: sha-only: manual "temporary" shadow value (post Phase-1 rename of `modifier`).

RawStat.description:
A single ability stat as persisted.

Dropped as DERIVED (recomputed by Stats.tsx on read): modifier · check · total · extraBonusComputed · race (legacy).

Dropped as DECOMMISSIONED (Phase 5): origin · extraBonusExpr — parallel score scalars removed from the live calc. Racial/background ASI is to be expressed as a `stat.X.score` bonus (source `origin`) when the wizard is wired; see docs/plans/data-hygiene.md.

NOTE on `sha` (shadow stat): its manual "temporary" value lives in `shadowTemp` AFTER the Phase 1 rename (was overloaded onto `modifier`). For every normal stat `modifier` is purely derived — hence it is intentionally absent from the whitelist. Do not wire `pickRawStat` for `sha` before that rename, or the temporary is lost.

dmg.description: Damage formula, e.g. `2к6+[str]`. Parsed by `@tldrpg/dice` (`prepareSheetFormula` in `src/utils/rollService`), which looks variables up case-insensitively — `[str]`/`[STR]`/`[Str]` are all equivalent here. This differs from the numeric-context formula fields elsewhere on the character (AC, speed, save/skill overrides, …), which are read by `evaluateExpression()` and do NOT case-fold — those require the exact `[UPPERCASE]` spelling. See `docs/plans/character-toolkit.md`.

modCustom.description: Legacy manual attack modifier of the old 'none' mode. Accepted on import; converted into `modBonus` on load (migrateWeaponModCustom).

modBonus.description: Legacy flat attack bonus (pre-bonus-system); kept until converted.

RawWeapon.description:
A `weaponsList` entry as persisted.

Dropped as DERIVED (rebuilt by Weapons.tsx on read):   mod (the {value,bonus} object — raw input is modBonus) ·   damageBonus · damageRoll · displayDamage · damageDisplay ·   hasAttackOverride · hasDamageOverride

template.description: Visual/label skin. `aime`/`aime-pbs` additionally unlock the `sha` stat, `cor` save, `riddle`/`shadow-lore` skills, and a 3-denomination (gp/sp/cp) coin purse instead of 5. Everything else is cosmetic labels, not new mechanics.

info.description: Header fields. All are the `{ name, value }` wrapper.

id.description: Optional dataset classId reference; free text is fine without it. Bare id, no dataset-source prefix — `cleric`, not `srd-2024:cleric`. This differs from `bonuses[*].source.refId`, which IS prefixed (`srd-2024:cleric`) — that field identifies dataset CONTENT provenance across sources with the same bare id, a different lookup than this one.

Optional dataset subclassId reference; free text is fine without it. Bare id, no dataset-source prefix — `cleric`, not `srd-2024:cleric`. This differs from `bonuses[*].source.refId`, which IS prefixed (`srd-2024:cleric`) — that field identifies dataset CONTENT provenance across sources with the same bare id, a different lookup than this one.

Optional dataset backgroundId reference; free text is fine without it. Bare id, no dataset-source prefix — `cleric`, not `srd-2024:cleric`. This differs from `bonuses[*].source.refId`, which IS prefixed (`srd-2024:cleric`) — that field identifies dataset CONTENT provenance across sources with the same bare id, a different lookup than this one.

Optional dataset raceId reference; free text is fine without it. Bare id, no dataset-source prefix — `cleric`, not `srd-2024:cleric`. This differs from `bonuses[*].source.refId`, which IS prefixed (`srd-2024:cleric`) — that field identifies dataset CONTENT provenance across sources with the same bare id, a different lookup than this one.

subrace.description: Optional. Not the `{ name, value }` wrapper like its siblings — just `id`/`value`.

id.description: Bare dataset subraceId — same convention as `race.id`.

value.description: Total XP. `""` is the only valid string value — the unset default on a fresh character. The UI and leveling math treat this as a number; do not write formatted/free-text values (e.g. "34 000").

size.description: Optional. Drives carry/drag/food/water. Absent = treated as no size (all zero).

subInfo.description: Flavor fields, all optional-in-practice `{ name, value }` strings.

spellsInfo.description: Spellcasting stat block — display/override fields, not spell content.

customModifier.description: Formula string, evaluated in NUMERIC context. Ability-modifier variables MUST be written `[UPPERCASE]` — `[DEX]`, not `[dex]` or `[Dex]`: this field is read by an evaluator that does not case-fold the variable name, so anything but the exact uppercase spelling silently resolves to nothing and the field computes as 0. Available: `[STR]`/`[DEX]`/`[CON]`/`[INT]`/`[WIS]`/`[CHA]` (ability MODIFIER, not score), `[PROF]`, `[LVL]`. The rest of the string is evaluated with mathjs, so e.g. half-proficiency is `round([PROF]/2)` — dice notation (`1d6`) is NOT specially handled here (unlike weapon `dmg`), don't use it. Example: `10+[DEX]`. Full override of the computed spell save DC. `null` when the override has been cleared in the UI — clearing does not delete the key.

The rest of the string is evaluated with mathjs, so e.g. half-proficiency is `round([PROF]/2)` — dice notation (`1d6`) is NOT specially handled here (unlike weapon `dmg`), don't use it. Example: `10+[DEX]`. Full override of the computed spell attack modifier. `null` when the override has been cleared in the UI — clearing does not delete the key.

charges.description: Spell id → resource id (`data.resources`). The counter a spell is paid with when it is cast without a slot — «once per long rest» and the like (docs/plans/spell-casting-modes.md §3). Deliberately a reference rather than a counter of its own: several spells may share one pool, and rest recovery, copy/paste identity and hand-editing are already solved for resources. A resource referenced here needs no editor node — the load-time orphan sweep treats a binding as reachability.

abilities.description: Spell id → ability code (`str`|`dex`|`con`|`int`|`wis`|`cha`). Which ability casts THIS spell, when it differs from the sheet-wide `base.code` (docs/plans/spell-casting-modes.md §5). A missing key means «inherit the sheet's». Lives on the character rather than on the spell because the spell collection is deduplicated by content hash across all players — «cast with Charisma» would leak into every other player's copy. Fixes multiclassing too: a cleric/wizard casts cleric spells with Wisdom and wizard spells with Intelligence, and one sheet-wide field cannot say both.

available.description: Extra dataset classIds to widen the spell-list query beyond `info.charClass.id` (e.g. a feat granting a second casting class). Rarely needed for a fresh character. `spells` (docs/plans/spellcasting-model.md §7) widens it per-spell instead of per-class — individual spell ids that should be visible in the picker regardless of class list.

classes.description: Bare dataset classIds, same form as `info.charClass.id` (e.g. `warlock`, not `srd-2024:warlock`) — see that field for why.

spells.description: Spell-slot COUNTS only — not spell content. Keys are `slots-<circle>` for circles 0–9, where 0 is cantrips (always inert bookkeeping — cantrips cost no slot, so `slots-0` never carries a meaningful `value`) and 1–9 are real spell levels (spellbook contents — which spells are known/prepared — live in a separate backend column referencing real Spell documents by database id; this schema does not cover them, see docs/plans/character-toolkit.md). `value` may be absent: rest recovery writes `filled` for every circle unconditionally, including circles the character has no slots in yet, so a generator producing a fresh character should normally omit any circle with zero slots entirely, but a validator checking a real export must accept `{ "filled": 0 }` with no `value` as valid.

value.description: Total slots of this level. Absent = the character has none at this circle yet.

spellsPact.description: Spell-slot COUNTS only — not spell content. Keys are `slots-<circle>` for circles 0–9, where 0 is cantrips (always inert bookkeeping — cantrips cost no slot, so `slots-0` never carries a meaningful `value`) and 1–9 are real spell levels (spellbook contents — which spells are known/prepared — live in a separate backend column referencing real Spell documents by database id; this schema does not cover them, see docs/plans/character-toolkit.md). `value` may be absent: rest recovery writes `filled` for every circle unconditionally, including circles the character has no slots in yet, so a generator producing a fresh character should normally omit any circle with zero slots entirely, but a validator checking a real export must accept `{ "filled": 0 }` with no `value` as valid. This tracker is for Warlock pact-magic slots specifically; same shape as `spells`.

value.description: Total slots of this level. Absent = the character has none at this circle yet.

bonuses.description: Numeric modifiers from any source (manual, wizard-granted feature, attunement, condition, …). This is the ONLY bonus channel to author. `bonusesSkills`/`bonusesStats` are a separate, deprecated map-shaped channel — not superseded yet, still live for a couple of UI toggles — intentionally not part of this schema because their replacement (folding into `bonuses` here, in an as-yet-undecided shape) hasn't shipped. Do not author them; a validator checking a real export should tolerate seeing them.

effects.description: Named sets of bonuses switched on and off as a whole (Stone of Good Luck, Bless). The record holds the name, description and on/off; its numeric changes are ordinary `bonuses[]` entries with `source: { kind: 'effect', refId: <effect id>, label: <effect name> }`. An effect that is off, or missing, switches its bonuses off.

proficiency.description: Base proficiency bonus (normally level-derived: 2 at 1–4, +1 every 4 levels).

proficiencyCustom.description: Override of `proficiency` if set. Every reader treats this as `proficiencyCustom || proficiency` — `0` is falsy, so it reads as ABSENT, not as an override to zero. There is currently no way to force proficiency to 0 through this field.

stats.description: `str/dex/con/int/wis/cha` are required. `sha` (Пункты Тени) only applies to aime templates — its `shadowTemp` field (not `score`) holds the manual "temporary" value.

saves.description: `str/dex/con/int/wis/cha` are required. `cor` (Соблазн) only applies to aime templates.

isProf.description: 0/false = not proficient, 1/true = proficient, 2 = expertise (saving-throw expertise is rare but the field accepts it).

bonusExpr.description: Formula string, evaluated in NUMERIC context. Ability-modifier variables MUST be written `[UPPERCASE]` — `[DEX]`, not `[dex]` or `[Dex]`: this field is read by an evaluator that does not case-fold the variable name, so anything but the exact uppercase spelling silently resolves to nothing and the field computes as 0. Available: `[STR]`/`[DEX]`/`[CON]`/`[INT]`/`[WIS]`/`[CHA]` (ability MODIFIER, not score), `[PROF]`, `[LVL]`. Ability-modifier variables MUST be written `[UPPERCASE]` — `[DEX]`, not `[dex]` or `[Dex]`: this field is read by an evaluator that does not case-fold the variable name, so anything but the exact uppercase spelling silently resolves to nothing and the field computes as 0. Available: `[STR]`/`[DEX]`/`[CON]`/`[INT]`/`[WIS]`/`[CHA]` (ability MODIFIER, not score), `[PROF]`, `[LVL]`. The rest of the string is evaluated with mathjs, so e.g. half-proficiency is `round([PROF]/2)` — dice notation (`1d6`) is NOT specially handled here (unlike weapon `dmg`), don't use it. Example: `10+[DEX]`. Formula override for the skill bonus.

value.description: Custom override formula. `null` = use DEX modifier (default).

checked.description: Attunement slot filled. Also gates any bonus whose `source.kind` is `attunement` with a matching `refId`.

text.description: Rich-text blocks (traits, features, equipment, personality, notes…). Keys are template-defined block ids, not a fixed set — common ones: `attacks`, `weapons`, `traits`, `feats`, `equipment`, `attunement`, `prof`, `personality`, `ideals`, `bonds`, `flaws`, `features`, `background`, `quests`, `allies`, `appearance`, `notes-1`…`notes-6`, `items`.

data.description: A Tiptap/ProseMirror document. Minimal valid shape: `{"type":"doc","content":[{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"..."}]}]}`. Marks (bold/italic/underline/link) live on `text` nodes as a `marks` array. Special node types (`roller`, `formula`, `resource`, `divider`, `spoiler`/`spoilerSummary`/`spoilerContent`, `taskList`/`taskItem`) exist but are not validated here — if unsure, stick to `paragraph`/`text`/`bulletList`/`orderedList`/`listItem`. `blockquote` is NOT currently a registered node type despite looking like a standard one — do not use it. An unrecognized node type is not a soft failure: the editor has no error boundary, so it throws and takes down the whole text block's rendering, not just that one node.

size.description: Template-specific layout hint (e.g. column span). Optional, template-defined.

coins.description: Denominations, each optional. `total` is DERIVED (computed in gp) — never author it.

resources.description: Keyed by the resource's own `id` (matching the key is expected, not enforced by this schema).

additionalProperties.description: A counter (ki points, arrows, rage uses, …). Exactly one of `max`/`maxExpr` should be set. Do not author `resolvedMax`/`resolvedShortRegain` (derived — as of this schema version no longer written by the app either, but older saved resources may still carry it) or `orphanedAt`/`isDeleted` (present below only because a real export legitimately has them, always absent/false on a freshly authored resource).

maxExpr.description: Formula string, evaluated in NUMERIC context. Ability-modifier variables MUST be written `[UPPERCASE]` — `[DEX]`, not `[dex]` or `[Dex]`: this field is read by an evaluator that does not case-fold the variable name, so anything but the exact uppercase spelling silently resolves to nothing and the field computes as 0. Available: `[STR]`/`[DEX]`/`[CON]`/`[INT]`/`[WIS]`/`[CHA]` (ability MODIFIER, not score), `[PROF]`, `[LVL]`. The rest of the string is evaluated with mathjs, so e.g. half-proficiency is `round([PROF]/2)` — dice notation (`1d6`) is NOT specially handled here (unlike weapon `dmg`), don't use it. Example: `10+[DEX]`. Formula for max; mutually exclusive with `max`. `null` when the field has been cleared in the UI — clearing does not delete the key.

location.description: The `text` block key whose doc contains this resource's node.

shortRestRegain.description: Formula string, evaluated in NUMERIC context. Ability-modifier variables MUST be written `[UPPERCASE]` — `[DEX]`, not `[dex]` or `[Dex]`: this field is read by an evaluator that does not case-fold the variable name, so anything but the exact uppercase spelling silently resolves to nothing and the field computes as 0. Available: `[STR]`/`[DEX]`/`[CON]`/`[INT]`/`[WIS]`/`[CHA]` (ability MODIFIER, not score), `[PROF]`, `[LVL]`. The rest of the string is evaluated with mathjs, so e.g. half-proficiency is `round([PROF]/2)` — dice notation (`1d6`) is NOT specially handled here (unlike weapon `dmg`), don't use it. Example: `10+[DEX]`. Partial short-rest refill amount; omit/null = full refill on short rest.

source.description: Provenance tag when granted by the wizard (e.g. a class feature id). Omit for player-authored counters.

orphanedAt.description: Text-editor undo/cut-paste lifecycle state. Never author this on a fresh resource — omit it.

isDeleted.description: Text-editor undo/cut-paste lifecycle state. Never author this on a fresh resource — omit it.

conditions.description: Active condition keys. The valid set depends on `template`'s rules edition (2014 vs 2024 condition lists differ) — see the template's `listConditions` in the app; not enumerated here because it is edition-dependent.

prof.description: Armor/weapon proficiency checkboxes. `armor-label` is the shield-proficiency slot (legacy key name, captioned "Shield" in the UI). All keys optional — absent means unchecked.

createdAt.description: Read-only. The backend's single-character GET endpoint stamps the sibling `createdAt` column into this blob before returning it, so any downloaded/fetched export carries it — a generator never needs to author it, and sending it back on save has no effect (the backend column is the source of truth, not this copy).
